zh-CN.title: 浮动查看，内容不挤
items: 聊天详情、个人名片等在聊天和广场中以浮动框打开，不再挤压当前内容
广场列表保留更舒适的宽度，窄面板中的发表按钮不再换行

en.title: Floating views, undisturbed content
items: Chat details, profile cards and other secondary views float above Chats and Square without squeezing the current content
Square lists have more breathing room, with compact publish buttons that stay on one line
